description: This file is a shell script used for setting up GRE tunnels, network interfaces, and system configurations related to Hotspot and GRE tunnel management.

methods.name: init_snooper_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes system events for snooper circuits and remote enablement.

methods.name: read_init_params
methods.description: Retrieves initial parameters from the PSM database for GRE tunnel configuration.

methods.name: create_tunnel
methods.description: Creates and configures GRE tunnel interfaces and bridge interfaces.

methods.name: init_keepalive_sysevents
methods.description: Sets system events for keepalive settings.

methods.name: update_bridge_config
methods.description: Sets iptables rules for bridge traffic filtering.
